summary: The change adds namespace enforcement in the public KV dispatcher, scopes the new optional Passport bearer to auth/v1, preserves the private service binding boundary, and adds D1-backed tests covering signing, password, and other private prefixes. No introduced defect was found.

evidence: kv-service/src/worker.ts:305-330 adds `namespaceAllowed`, denying the shared bearer on exact `auth/v1` keys and prefixes across get, getMany, set, delete, list, and every atomic check or mutation.
kv-service/src/worker.ts:253-267 enforces the scoped check before dispatch, while AuthStoreEntrypoint remains restricted to `auth/v1` through the private binding.
tests/worker_runtime.mjs:483-556 seeds D1 private keys including `signing/current` and `password_credentials`, asserts the public bearer gets 403, and verifies zero writes.
docs/CLOUDFLARE.md:15-19 documents the shared/PASSPORT bearer boundary and deployment cutover requirement.
